purpose: Optional native-data capture aid; fill only observed fields. Missing analytics do not block release.
notes: One row is one asset/report scope and one native report window. Do not mix account-level and per-video metrics.
Record first public time from a verified release receipt; private upload time is not public age.
Keep exact native labels/units/definitions and raw evidence. Viewers is not Reach; aggregate shares is not DM sends.
Known publication/capture timestamps supply effective age. A declared first-public window is not verified unless exact endpoints agree.
A total-video watch-time count cannot replace watch time attributed to registered thumbnail impressions.
Do not fill unavailable fields with zero, reconstruct erased historical counters, or infer revenue from views.
Each widget can have a different scope/cutoff on the same page. Retain physical table labels, processing notices and incidental preview activity.

observations.distribution_notes: Ordinary organic / paid / boosted / Trial / mixed / unknown; record actual exposure, not an assumed setting.
